notes.title: Version 1.01 New picture locations.
notes.content:
Fixed some things, and made the pictures way easier to find. 

Also fixed:
Shrunk the demons NavMesh, so now she can no longer enter the ritual room.
Drumstick location is now easier to find.
Small Audio tweaks with the 3D effect.
Shrunk the teleport animation a littlebit so it doesn't illuminate too much.
Changed credits slightly.

Thanks guys.
